articles.title: Wells Fargo Recruits $1.2 Billion Advisory Team From Citigroup
articles.mainIdea: Wells Fargo Recruits $1.2 Billion Advisory Team From Citigroup
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Wells Fargo Recruits $1.2 Billion Advisory Team From Citigroup. Wells Fargo has recruited an advisory duo in Texas managing $1.2 billion in client assets. Paul Cooke and Jake Trousdale have joined Wells Fargo’s Private Client Group in Dallas. The move comes amid a reorganization within Citigroup that will see a new CFO take over in March and the firm’s retail banking operations be consolidated and organized within the wealth business, headed by Andy Sieg. Related tickers mentioned: C.
